subject: general
question: Which of the following steps correctly describes renaming a file or folder using the File menu?

options.text: Select the file/folder → Click File → Rename → Type the new name → Press Enter
Right-click on the folder → Select Copy → Rename
Select the folder → Press Delete → Type a new name
Open the folder → Click View → Rename → Type the new name.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 1**: *Select the file/folder → Click File → Rename → Type the new name → Press Enter*. This is the correct sequence for renaming a file or folder using the File menu. This method ensures proper execution, and pressing **Enter** confirms the change. *Hence, this option is correct.*
 
• **Option 2**: *Right-click on the folder → Select Copy → Rename*. This option is incorrect because copying does not rename a file or folder. Copying creates a duplicate without changing the original name. Renaming is an independent process and doesn’t involve copying. *Hence, this option is incorrect.*
 
• **Option 3**: *Select the folder → Press Delete → Type a new name*. This option is incorrect as deleting a folder removes it permanently or sends it to the recycle bin, and typing a new name afterward does not rename the deleted item. *Hence, this option is incorrect.*
 
• **Option 4**: *फोल्डर ओपन करें → View क्लिक करें → Rename करें → नया नाम टाइप करें*. This option is incorrect because renaming does not require opening the folder or using the View menu. Renaming can be done directly from the File menu or by right-clicking on the folder. *Hence, this option is incorrect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Steps to Rename a File or Folder:**

 
 
• Using the File menu: The user should **select the file or folder**, go to the **File menu**, click on **Rename**, and then type the new name followed by pressing **Enter**.
 
• Using the context menu: Right-click on the file or folder and select **Rename**. Then, type the new name and press **Enter** to confirm.
 
 
 
• **Keyboard Shortcut:**
 
 
• A faster way to rename a file or folder is by selecting it and pressing the **F2 key**. This opens the renaming mode directly.
 
• After typing the new name, pressing **Enter** confirms the change.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Renaming Files:**
 
 
• Renaming helps in organizing files and folders systematically.
 
• It improves accessibility by providing meaningful names to files or folders.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **File Management Functions:**

 
 
• **Renaming:** Assigning new names to files or folders for better identification.
 
• **Copying:** Creating duplicates of files or folders.
 
• **Deleting:** Removing files or folders permanently or sending them to the recycle bin.
 
• **View Menu Functions:** Used for adjusting the display settings but not for renaming files or folders.
 
 
 
• **Best Practices in File Renaming:**
 
 
• Use descriptive names to easily identify the contents of a file or folder.
 
• Avoid using special characters that may not be supported by the system.
